rank_explanation: Rank 1: Highest historical mean irradiance (5.34 kWh/m^2/day) and highest median (5.40 kWh/m^2/day), providing the premier preliminary solar resource among candidate sites.
Rank 2: Strong runner-up resource with 5.23 kWh/m^2/day mean, lowest low-solar day frequency (8.2% < 3.5 kWh/m^2/day), and lowest coefficient of variation (0.230).
Rank 3: Consistent southern plateau resource with 5.20 kWh/m^2/day mean, solid spring insolation peak, and 8.7% low-solar days.
Rank 4: Lowest mean irradiance (5.08 kWh/m^2/day) and highest low-solar day frequency (9.8% < 3.5 kWh/m^2/day, 248 days), placing fourth among the four candidate areas.
